name: delegation
description: Typed read-only subagents (investigator, researcher, reviewer, skeptic), a guard on catch-all ones (off, log, block), and a measure of how sessions delegate to subagents and where the main session's context goes: typed share of agent calls, delegated writes, subagent starting context, peak context, large results, MCP volume; snapshots and a before/after compare

guard_mode.title: Guard mode for catch-all subagents
guard_mode.description: What the guard-agent-type hook does with an Agent call of no type, general-purpose, claude or fork: off (nothing), log (let it through and record a would-block event, which measure counts as M9), block (refuse it and name the typed roles). DELEGATION_GUARD_MODE overrides it for one session
